summary: Backend-only validation completed for combined Renewable Energy % flow via /api/internal-ai/chat using admin and restricted users. 6 targeted tests executed: 5 passed, 1 failed.

critical.issue: Combined renewable ledger includes duplicate Scope 1 source rows (8 rows returned, only 5 unique tuples), causing denominator inflation risk.

action_items: Deduplicate Scope 1 and Scope 2 sources before computing combined denominator/numerator in renewable ledger response path.
Ensure emissions.search_records excludes superseded/soft-deleted records (align with ESG active-record filtering) or dedupe by stable record identity before ledger aggregation.
Expose source identifiers (record id/facility) in ghg_energy components to make duplicate tracing/audit deterministic.
critical_code_review_comments: modules/internal_data_ai/services/emissions.py::search_records does not apply active-record guard similar to ESG service; this can surface duplicate/superseded records into energy calculations.

modules/internal_data_ai/services/emissions.py::get_renewable_energy_components emits scope2_electricity rows without source identity fields, making duplicate detection and authorization audits harder.
modules/internal_data_ai/response_builder.py::_build_combined_renewable_energy_response aggregates rows as-is; no deduplication or source-level guard before final formula output.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Current live output still shows combined formula and expected Environment 500/10000 kJ source, scope2 energy activity units, and RBAC restriction for restricted user. Remaining blocker is duplicate source inclusion in combined ledger components.
rca of the issue: Reproduction: Query admin with 'how much renewable energy % for FY 2026-2027' and inspect raw_data.ghg_energy.scope1_calculations. Identical tuples repeat (e.g., Residual Fuel Oil 2026-08, Natural Gas FY 2026-2027, Petrol 2026-06). Likely cause: emissions search path does not filter to active/current records and combined builder does not dedupe before sum, so duplicate rows are counted in denominator. Mitigation: apply active-record constraints in emissions lookup and/or dedupe by stable source key (record id + period + facility + fuel/electricity attributes) before aggregation.
